newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK VOLUME, TURNOVER RISE.

text.p: Turnover rose to 176,760 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 2,700 denars on Thursday as two companies traded, the exchange said.
Oteks Ohrid sold 50 shares at 150 denars, unchanged from the previous close and below par of 1,941 denars.
A total of 124 Usie shares sold at 1,365 denars, flat from Thursday's close and below par of 2,665 denars.
Traded volume was 18 shares at the previous session on Thursday when only Oteks stocks traded.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
